messages:
Maya S: quick question — are we comfortable adding a per-tenant dry_run flag to the runtime-config API? want a console UX that lets PMs preview the effects without touching quotas or routes
Andrew P: curious what 'preview' would actually simulate. traffic routing? quota consumption? telemetry?
Maya S: all of the above ideally. preview should run the decision logic (routing + quota accounting) and produce a delta report but not mutate any routing tables or counters. also it should attach a 'safepoint' token so ops can replay the same conditions later.
Lucas R: so basically: evaluate the config against a sample of live traffic and show what would have changed. we can do sampling client-side with cohort ids. downside = extra load on evaluator service.
Tiago N: main API change is tiny: add dry_run:true and optional sample_rate and safepoint_id. example payload: ```json
{
  "config": { /* big config blob */ },
  "dry_run": true,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "safepoint_id": "sp-2026-03-21-01"
}
```
Kim (SRE): important: preview must not alter counters used for autoscaling or billing. those counters are used elsewhere. so evaluator must write to ephemeral metrics or just return a delta without emitting production metrics.
Andrew P: can we reuse the existing evaluation lambda? it already computes routing decisions for canaries. but it persists some telemetry. we'd need a mode switch to avoid persistence.
Lucas R: UX question — how does the console surface results? a table of affected routes + expected p95 latency delta + projected token cost delta? also a visualization for cohort overlap.
Maya S: exactly. console should show: 1) route mapping changes (which requests would be routed differently) 2) quota burn impact (tokens/sec, daily) 3) safety signals if any fall outside thresholds (error rate, latency increase) 4) a link to create a rollback config from the preview (one-click).
Tiago N: implementation plan: evaluator service gets a new ephemeral mode. when dry_run=true it forks into a snapshot runner that consumes same input stream for sample RPS, annotates decisions, returns a report JSON. will avoid any side-effectful collectors.
Kim (SRE): operationally we need a hard limit: preview sample_rate <= 0.05 by default, and autosnoop guard to abort if sampled error rate > X or cost > Y. ops should be paged if a preview is touching sensitive configs (quota/grant).
Andrew P: API contract change: add a new response field preview_id + safepoint_id. clients can later call /preview/replay?safepoint=... to run the same assessment deterministically. keep TTL for safepoints = 7 days.
Maya S: question for Lucas: console affordance for 'tenant-scoped dry run' vs 'global dry run' — PMs want tenant-only so they can preview for one customer. how heavy is per-tenant evaluation?
Lucas R: tenant-only is fine — we already have tenant isolation in routing eval. cost is linear in sample size. UI should default to tenant-scoped and show an 'apply globally' checkbox with a warning.
Tiago N: dev concern: need to ensure preview mode respects feature-flag inheritance rules exactly. otherwise preview results will diverge from apply. so we must run the full config resolution codepath untouched.
Kim (SRE): also add an audit event for every preview run (non-sensitive metadata only: who ran it, tenant, sample_rate, safepoint_id) so we can trace usage. do not log full config blob in plaintext.
Andrew P: can ops-bot post a short summary to #eng-oncall when a preview exceeds any safety thresholds? e.g., "preview sp-2026-03-21-01 for tenant: acme exceeded latency threshold"
ops-bot: noted. I can post summaries if a webhook is provided. will also attach the preview_id and a link to the console preview page. :white_check_mark:
Maya S: next steps: Tiago to sketch API proto + evaluator changes, Lucas to wire up the console mockups, Kim to propose threshold defaults, Andrew to run quick dependency check on existing evaluator. i'll collate and we can sign off Tue sync.
Andrew P: assigning roughs: Tiago 2w, Lucas 1w mock, Kim ops policy doc 3 days. I'll unblock infra deps.
Lucas R: UX mock ETA next Fri, will attach screenshot to this thread when ready.
Tiago N: starting a prototype branch today. will ping once I have a smoke test that runs locally.
Maya S: awesome, thanks team. can we add a tiny checkbox in the console mock that says "simulate cost impact" so finance sees estimated monthly delta?
Kim (SRE): include that but gated to users with finance role.
Maya S: perfect. I'll update the RFC and drop a link here when live.
